info.title: OMS Build Queue Service
info.description: The TD/OMS Build Queue API manages the transfer of objects from a TD/OMS task to the build queue for compilation. It provides three operations: queue objects for compilation, release (submit) queued objects for batch processing, and delete objects from the queue. Use this API to control the compilation workflow, selecting individual objects or entire tasks for batch compilation.

port.description: The port to which the server is listening

/release.description: This action will release the build queue so that all objects in the queue are compiled. The submitted objects are tracked in the OMXCreateMonitor table with processingStatus transitioning from *OPEN â *SUBM â *COMP. Monitor createStatus for results: *NORM (success) or *TERM/*ABND (compilation error). Returns OMQF314 for individual object release or OMQF303 for entire task release.

post.description: This action releases all or one objects from the queue to be compiled. Start monitoring via OMXCreateMonitor table immediately after processing. Supply empty objectCode, objectType, and objectLibrary to release entire task queue at once.

/queue.summary: Add an object or a task to the build queue
/queue.description: This action will add an object or all development objects from a task to the build queue. Returns OMQF302 for successful single object queue, OMQF304 for partial success in bulk operations (some objects already queued), or OMQF312 when compile already requested. Queued objects appear in OMXCreateMonitor table with processingStatus=*OPEN. Verify queue operations by querying OMXCreateMonitor for the object with matching fixNumber and objectCode. Leave all object parameters empty to queue all development objects in the task at once.

post.summary: Queue object or task for compile
post.description: This operation is used to add one or more objects to the build queue. Use the Database Agent to verify the queue entry in OMXCreateMonitor table. Supply empty objectCode, objectType, and objectLibrary to queue all connected objects in a task.

/delete.summary: Clear a single object or multiple objects from the build queue.
/delete.description: This action will delete the single or multiple objects from the queue. Returns OMQF307 for single object deletion or OMQF309 when deleting entire task queue. Verify deletion by querying OMXCreateMonitor - deleted entries will return zero records for that object and task. Only objects with processingStatus *HOLD can be deleted; objects with status *SUBM (submitted) or *COMP (completed) cannot be deleted. Use clearAll=false to remove only last occurrence, or clearAll=true to remove all occurrences of the object.

post.summary: Delete the objects from the compile
post.description: This action deletes the single or multiple objects from the queue. Verify successful deletion using Database Agent query of OMXCreateMonitor table. Parameters: supply objectCode/Type/Library for single object deletion, or leave empty to delete entire task queue.

applicationCode.description: The TD/OMS application code (e.g., XMP, EXCP). Required for all operations.

taskNumber.description: The TD/OMS task number containing the object or objects to process (e.g., XT0762). Required for all operations.

objectCode.description: The object name to queue, release, or delete (e.g., OMH011). Leave empty to process all development objects in the task.

objectType.description: The object type (e.g., *PGM, *SERVICE, *MODULE, *FILE). Leave empty when objectCode is empty.

objectLibrary.description: The development library containing the object (e.g., O_XT0762D). Leave empty when objectCode is empty.

detail.description: Optional detail code or member code. For source file members (objectType=*FILE), pass the memberCode here (e.g., 'AS400'). For other object types, leave empty or omit.

request.description: Request parameters for build queue operations. Specify applicationCode and taskNumber (required). To operate on a specific object, provide objectCode, objectType, and objectLibrary. To process all development objects in the task, leave object-related fields empty.

status.description: *NORM indicates the operation was successful. Status is returned from all operations: queue, release, and delete.

response.description: Response contains operation result (messageId) and status. Message IDs include: OMQF302 (object queued), OMQF303 (task queue released), OMQF304 (partial queue success), OMQF307 (object deleted), OMQF309 (task queue cleared), OMQF312 (already queued), OMQF314 (object released), OMQ400E (object not found).

clearAll.description: Controls delete operation scope (applies only to /delete endpoint). When false, removes only the last occurrence of the specified object from the queue. When true, removes all occurrences of the specified object from the queue.

processingArray.description: Processing control flags. clearAll applies to the /delete endpoint to control whether to delete a single queue entry or all entries for the object.
